registry.toolPhotoDesc: Shoot on your phone straight into your own object storage; the desktop pulls and archives in batches

photo.providerS3Hint: Tencent COS / MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / AWS S3
photo.notConfigured: Storage not configured yet. You can still shoot photos—they are queued locally and uploaded automatically once configured.
photo.configOk: Connected ({n} photo(s) already in the cloud)
photo.configTestDesktopOnly: Connectivity test for this backend runs on the desktop (browser CORS limits); on the phone just upload one photo to verify
photo.qiniuOk: Credentials and bucket name are valid: upload host {host}
photo.qiniu_accessKey: Wrong AccessKey: the region API said "{message}". Make sure this AK belongs to the account that owns the bucket (sub-accounts need the bucket permission)
photo.qiniu_bucket: Wrong bucket name: the region API said "{message}". Put the bucket name itself, not a CDN domain
photo.qiniu_network: Region API unreachable: {message}. Check that this device can reach api.qiniu.com
photo.cloudHint: Reads the remote directly: lists objects under "{prefix}/" (phone and desktop uploads both show up here). Preview, rename (move) and delete are supported. Private buckets use a temporary download token valid for one hour.
photo.cloudDeleteUnknown: The delete request went out but the object is still listed (the browser cannot read the response because of CORS). Refresh to check, or delete from the Android app.
photo.cloudUnsupported: Browsing the cloud from the phone is not supported for this backend yet: Qiniu and S3 are supported; WebDAV listing needs PROPFIND with per-server CORS rules, so it is not offered.
photo.qiniuProbeOk: Self-check passed: a probe object really uploaded ({key}, 1 byte — you can delete it in the Qiniu console). Credentials and the upload path both work; go back to the queue and hit Retry.
photo.qiniuSecretKey: Wrong SecretKey: the bucket and AccessKey are valid (the region API knows them) but the upload token was rejected. Make sure SK and AK are the same key pair of the same account (swapped fields or a truncated copy are the usual causes).
photo.qiniuClock: Device clock skew: Qiniu treats the upload token as expired. Fix the clock on this device (anything beyond an hour triggers this) and run the self-check again.
photo.fieldDomainPh: e.g. cdn.example.com (domain bound to the bucket)
photo.fieldUploadHostPh: Defaults to upload.qiniup.com; usually no change needed
photo.fieldPrivateBucket: Private bucket (downloads need a signed token)
photo.providerQiniuHint: Form upload: no extra CORS setup needed for browser / phone
photo.providerWebdavHint: Jianguoyun / Synology / Nextcloud: simple protocol, but browser direct upload depends on the server allowing CORS
photo.providerWebdavBrowserWarn: Most public WebDAV servers do not send CORS headers, and every upload from the phone goes through the browser (the page inside the Android app is a browser too), so it fails with "Failed to fetch". To upload from the phone, add CORS headers on the WebDAV server or reverse proxy — or switch to an S3-compatible / Qiniu backend.
photo.errDomainBad: Access domain must be a bare host (optional port)
photo.errUploadHostBad: Upload host must be a bare host
photo.transferHint: Set up multiple devices quickly: export on one device, paste-import on another.
photo.exportHint: Full config with plaintext keys—copy it and paste into “Import settings” on another device. Share it with no one else.
photo.importHint: Paste the exported text here (either the whole export or just its config part):
photo.copyFail: Auto-copy unavailable—long-press to select and copy manually
photo.importBadJson: Not a valid export (expected the exported JSON text)
photo.importBadKind: This is not a Photo Archive storage export
photo.importBadVersion: This export is from a newer version—update the app first
photo.importBadProvider: Unknown storage backend—check the provider field
photo.fieldPathStyle: Path-style addressing (usually required by self-hosted MinIO)
photo.errEndpointBad: Endpoint must be a bare host (optional port), without https:// or a path
photo.errRelayUrlBad: Use a full https:// address; for a local test http://127.0.0.1:8127/ works (see docs/photo-relay.md)
photo.errPrefixBad: Prefix allows only letters, digits and / . _ -
photo.errBlobMissing: Local photo data is gone; please shoot or pick it again
photo.webSecretWarn: The web build has no system keystore, so credentials are stored as local data (the Android app and desktop encrypt them). Prefer a sub-account key limited to upload/list on this bucket.
photo.webHint: Keep the page in the foreground while uploading (locking the screen or switching away pauses it). Unfinished photos stay queued and resume automatically next time; on iPhone you can add it to the Home Screen.
photo.emptyQueue: No photos yet. Shoot or pick some—they are stored in the local queue first and never lost before upload succeeds.
photo.uploadedEmpty: No uploads yet. Once a photo is uploaded, a local preview stays here for review.
photo.uploadedHint: From this device's upload history; tap to enlarge (local preview).
photo.previewLocal: Local preview thumbnail (the original lives in the cloud).
photo.emptyCloud: No photos in the cloud yet. Shoot and upload on your phone first, then come back to archive.
photo.needSelection: Select photos to archive (or click "Select all new")
photo.canceledNote: Canceled; already downloaded files stay in the archive folder
photo.uploadHint: In the browser build you can upload local photos; use the mobile page for camera capture and the desktop app for batch archiving.
